title: DepRisk symbol map (v1)
description: A curated list of the public entry points (symbols) through which application code reaches the flaw of an advisory in a package. Input of 'deprisk reach --symbols'. OSV carries no such data for NuGet, so it has to come from here. See docs/symbol-maps.md.

advisory.description: An advisory id or one of its aliases (for example a CVE id); matched ignoring case.

package.description: The NuGet package id; matched ignoring case.

symbols.description: Namespace.Type.Member, Namespace.Type.#ctor (constructors), or Namespace.Type.* (any member, including constructors).

complete.description: True only if the list is claimed to contain every public way to reach the flaw. Required, no default: without true, a missing path is 'unknown', never 'unreachable'.

source.description: Provenance: who or what says these are the symbols (a reference, a commit, an analyst).
